limits: Post return is not delivery acknowledgment; pre/post output witnesses do not prove every main raster frame.

gitcomet.reviewer: OpenAI Codex automated offline/visual inspection, not human review
gitcomet.return_error_rows_kind: Maximum of measured integrated return error and conservative2logicalpoint registration resolution, divided by unchanged observed rowheight. Direct registration must also be within2logicalpoints and confident; no calibrated subpixel precision claim
gitcomet.scope: Automated post-main output geometry outside energy windows; compact numeric witness only. Full video/private acquisition controls are not in this packet; does not prove every main raster frame, capture latency, physical feel, or equivalent output.
